C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES.IntentSummary: Turn the fullscreen table viewer into a pan-only horizontal surface with live edge clipping shadows: overflowX always hidden, a pure tableClipShadows bounds function driving two gradient overlays, shadow refresh on every pan/zoom/fit/open, and the FIX-008 e2e rewritten to prove no bar exists while drag still reveals the last column and the shadow sides track the pan position.
C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES.ExecutionPolicy: Execute sequentially after C-73/C-74 land. The shared M-012/V-M-012 durable scope overlaps C-TABLE-FOOTER (both edit the viewer/table surface family); the overlap is acknowledged — this bundle touches only ui/blockViewer files and its own tests, never the tableResize/tableCue/renderContainerBlock files C-TABLE-FOOTER owns.

MustContain.Text: reopened for one pan model plus edge clipping shadows

Corner.Name: Correctness — no false bar
Corner.Expected: overflowX computes to hidden for the table canvas at every zoom in both engines; no bottom track is painted anywhere; scrollLeft stays 0; the guard that previously re-derived per-axis overflow is replaced, not merely bypassed.

Corner.Name: Correctness — shadow truth
Corner.Expected: tableClipShadows derives both sides from the transformed canvas rect versus the stage rect with a 1px tolerance; unit pins cover left bound (right only), middle (both), right bound (left only), fully fitted (neither) and the sub-pixel case; the live refresh runs on open, fit, 1:1, zoom and every panzoomchange so the cues never lie about the current position.

Corner.Name: Correctness — navigation still works
Corner.Expected: Drag pan reveals the last column of the 18-column fixture at 1:1 in both engines; wheel keeps native vertical scrolling for the capped sticky-header case and pans otherwise; no keyboard or focus behavior regresses (zoom keys, Esc, focus trap).

Corner.Name: Correctness — vertical independence
Corner.Expected: The vertical axis still computes to auto exactly when the scaled content is taller than the stage (maxHeight cap logic untouched); the sticky header keeps sticking at 1:1.

Corner.Name: Correctness — failing-on-bae95a97
Corner.Expected: The rewritten regression demonstrates the defect contract: on bae95a97 the track exists at 1:1 (overflowX auto) while providing no meaningful range — the new assertion overflowX hidden fails on that revision and passes after the repair; the last-column reveal assertion pins that removing the bar costs no navigation.

Corner.Name: Security and Privacy
Corner.Expected: Test-only fixtures are synthetic markdown tables; no owner content, no paths outside the repo and /tmp/mark-e2e; no secrets.

Corner.Name: UX
Corner.Expected: Shadows are subtle non-interactive gradients that never block pointer events (drag-through), fade with a short transition, and appear only for table sources; diagrams keep their exact current behavior.

Corner.Name: Performance
Corner.Expected: Shadow refresh reads two getBoundingClientRect values per panzoom event (no layout thrash beyond the existing transform writes); CSS uses opacity transitions on compositor-friendly gradients; no new dependency.

Corner.Name: Scope hygiene
Corner.Expected: blockViewer files and the bundle's own tests only; C-TABLE-FOOTER-owned files (tableResize, tableCue, renderContainerBlock, table-* specs) are not touched; the durable overlap is disclosed in the execution policy.

Corner.Name: Delivery discipline
Corner.Expected: The bundle repairs and verifies; it queues nothing. Returning FIX-008 to the queued table requires owner acceptance on a fresh isolated artifact identified by source, bundle id and binary SHA-256 (EP-01 exit gate).

T-001.Title: Pure shadow-state maths and unit pins

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tableClipShadows(contentLeft, contentRight, stageLeft, stageRight) exported from ui/blockViewer with the 1px tolerance; tests/renderer/muya/block-viewer-pan-cues.test.js pins left/middle/right/fit and the sub-pixel case and fails loudly on shape drift.

T-002.Title: Viewer repair: overflowX hidden, clip overlays, live refresh

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: updateTableOverflow is replaced by a vertical-only scroll derivation (auto exactly when scaled content exceeds the stage height); two gradient overlays are built in the stage and toggled by a tableClipShadows-driven refresh wired into open, fitToScreen, actualSize and panzoomchange; wheel handling keeps native vertical scroll and pans otherwise; module contract VERSION/CHANGE_SUMMARY/MAP updated.

The FIX-008 e2e is rewritten to the pan-cue contract (no horizontal bar at any zoom; drag reveals the last column; shadow sides track left/middle/right; Fit clears both) and passes with the full block-viewer spec in Chromium and WebKit; existing zoom, focus-trap, export, vertical-cap and sticky-header cases stay green.

Verification.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/block-viewer.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-block-viewer

T-004.Title: Projections, gate and fresh artifact handoff

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: V-M-012 scenario-19 describes the pan-only model and the clip cues, the unit command is recorded; grace lint --assertions current stays at zero errors; evidence.json records the runs; the repair is handed to the shared isolated Mark Test build for the owner's focused FIX-008 acceptance.
